description: This file defines a utility function 'formatStatusLabel' that converts raw deployment status codes into human-readable labels for display purposes. It handles null/undefined inputs, replaces delimiters with spaces, collapses multiple spaces, and converts text to Title Case, preserving apostrophes.

methods.name: formatStatusLabel(value)
methods.description: Converts a raw status code string (e.g., 'in_progress', 'FAILED') into a human-readable label (e.g., 'In Progress', 'Failed') by normalizing, replacing delimiters, collapsing spaces, and applying title casing while preserving apostrophes.
